content_sections.heading: Nagaland University Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Nagaland University Young Professional II Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Nagaland University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.heading: Nagaland University Young Professional II Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Young Professional II (YP II) post.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland University Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Sc Agri (Plant Pathology) with work experience on fungal and bacterial biocontrol agents for plant disease and pest management.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland University Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
Nagaland University Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Nagaland University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Young Professional-II (YP-II).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the YP-II post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is M.Sc Agri (Plant Pathology) with relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 42000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at Nagaland University, Medziphema, Nagaland - 797106.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
